question: Make this drawing move. File: ../art-feedback/evals/files/dog-sun.png
ground_truth: JSON with a duration between 2 and 10 seconds and one to three layers, each with a box inside the picture, a move from the closed vocabulary, and a time window inside the clip. Layer names describe shape, colour and position rather than naming what the shapes are.
expected_behavior: Every box has real width and height and sits inside the picture
Every move is one of drift, sway, rise, grow, breathe
Layer names describe appearance, not identity

question: The child said the creature walked away. Make the drawing move. File: ../art-feedback/evals/files/dog-sun.png
ground_truth: The visible region the child talked about gently moves in that direction and returns. Complete walking and disappearance are unsupported. Their own words may be used to name the layer.
expected_behavior: The local motion follows the child's intended direction without inventing a complete walking action
The child's own words may name a layer, because repeating them is not presuming
Nothing the child did not say is added

question: Make this drawing move. File: ../art-feedback/evals/files/scribble.png
ground_truth: A drawing nobody can identify still moves. Layers are named by shape and colour only, because there is nothing here anyone could name without guessing.
expected_behavior: No layer name claims what the marks are

question: Make this drawing move. File: ../art-feedback/evals/files/blank-page.png
ground_truth: There is nothing to move. The safety filter refuses a blank page before this skill runs; if it is reached anyway, an empty layer list is the honest answer and the gate reports that nothing moves.
expected_behavior: Does not invent shapes that are not on the page
